next:wr:34.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:34.hint: 来たくないなら来る必要はない
next:wr:34.answer: You need not come if you don't want to.
next:wr:34.fullSentence: You need not come if you don't want to.
next:wr:34.explanation: need not do『〜する必要はない』＝ don't need to do。needは助動詞用法だと否定文・疑問文で使われることが多い。
next:wr:34.relatedInfo: 肯定文ではneed to doの形になる。

next:wr:36.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:36.hint: よくもまああんなことを彼女に言えたものだ
next:wr:36.answer: How dare you say such a thing to her?
next:wr:36.fullSentence: How dare you say such a thing to her?
next:wr:36.explanation: How dare you ~?『よくも〜できるものだ』(強い非難・驚き)。
next:wr:36.relatedInfo: 感情のこもった修辞的な疑問文。

next:wr:38.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:38.hint: そのドアはどうしても開こうとしなかった(無生物の強い抵抗)
next:wr:38.answer: The door would not open, no matter how hard I pushed.
next:wr:38.fullSentence: The door would not open, no matter how hard I pushed.
next:wr:38.explanation: willの拒絶・強い意志用法(過去形would)は人だけでなく無生物にも使われる。
next:wr:38.relatedInfo: The door will not open.なら現在の話。

next:wr:40.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:40.hint: 今夜は出かけるよりむしろ家にいたい
next:wr:40.answer: I would rather stay home than go out tonight.
next:wr:40.fullSentence: I would rather stay home than go out tonight.
next:wr:40.explanation: would rather do『むしろ〜したい』。
next:wr:40.relatedInfo: would rather not do「むしろ〜したくない」もあわせて整理。

next:wr:41.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:41.hint: 混んだ電車に乗るよりむしろ歩きたい
next:wr:41.answer: I would rather walk than take the crowded train.
next:wr:41.fullSentence: I would rather walk than take the crowded train.
next:wr:41.explanation: would rather A than B『BよりむしろAしたい』。
next:wr:41.relatedInfo: 比較対象を伴うwould ratherの用法。

next:wr:43.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:43.hint: 今夜私たちの夕食に加わりませんか(丁寧な勧誘)
next:wr:43.answer: Would you like to join us for dinner tonight?
next:wr:43.fullSentence: Would you like to join us for dinner tonight?
next:wr:43.explanation: Would you like to do…?は丁寧な勧誘表現。
next:wr:43.relatedInfo: Do you want to ~?よりずっと丁寧。

next:wr:45.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:45.hint: 私は今、在宅勤務に慣れている
next:wr:45.answer: I am used to working from home now.
next:wr:45.fullSentence: I am used to working from home now.
next:wr:45.explanation: be used to doing『〜することに慣れている』。toは前置詞なので後ろは動名詞。
next:wr:45.relatedInfo: used to do(過去の習慣)と混同しないよう注意。

next:wr:47.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:47.hint: 雨が降りそうだ(すでにある兆候からの客観的な予測)
next:wr:47.answer: It's going to rain; look at those dark clouds.
next:wr:47.fullSentence: It's going to rain; look at those dark clouds.
next:wr:47.explanation: be going to doとwill doの違い。be going toはすでにある兆候からの客観的な予測。
next:wr:47.relatedInfo: will doは主観的・単純な未来の予測(It will rain.)。

next:wr:49.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:49.hint: もっと頑張っていれば彼は試験に受かっていたかもしれない
next:wr:49.answer: He could have passed the exam if he had tried harder.
next:wr:49.fullSentence: He could have passed the exam if he had tried harder.
next:wr:49.explanation: could have done『〜だったかもしれない、〜できたかもしれない(実際はしなかった)』。
next:wr:49.relatedInfo: 仮定法過去完了の帰結節としてもよく使われる。

next:wr:51.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:51.hint: そんなに食料を買う必要はなかったのに(実際は買ってしまった)
next:wr:51.answer: You needn't have bought so much food.
next:wr:51.fullSentence: You needn't have bought so much food.
next:wr:51.explanation: needn't have done『〜する必要はなかったのに(結局した)』。
next:wr:51.relatedInfo: didn't need to do「(不要だったので)しなかった」との違いに注意。

next:wr:53.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:53.hint: あなたの助けがなかったら、私はそのプロジェクトを完成できなかっただろう
next:wr:53.answer: If it had not been for your help, I could not have finished the project.
next:wr:53.fullSentence: If it had not been for your help, I could not have finished the project.
next:wr:53.explanation: 仮定法過去完了: If+S+had+Vpp, S+would/could/might+have+Vpp。
next:wr:53.relatedInfo: 「もし〜だったら…だっただろう」(過去の事実に反する仮定)。

next:wr:55.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:55.answer: It is time you went to bed.
next:wr:55.fullSentence: It is time you went to bed.
next:wr:55.explanation: It is time+S+過去形『もう〜してもよい時間だ』。
next:wr:55.relatedInfo: It is high time ~ とも言う(より強調)。

next:wr:57.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:57.hint: 彼はまるで幽霊を見たかのような顔をしていた
next:wr:57.answer: He looked as if he had seen a ghost.
next:wr:57.fullSentence: He looked as if he had seen a ghost.
next:wr:57.explanation: as if/as though+S+had+Vpp『まるで〜であったかのように』(過去の事実に反する)。
next:wr:57.relatedInfo: 主節より前の時であることを表す。

next:wr:59.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:59.hint: 大学でもっと勉強していればよかったのに
next:wr:59.answer: I wish I had studied harder in college.
next:wr:59.fullSentence: I wish I had studied harder in college.
next:wr:59.explanation: S wish S' had+Vpp『〜だったらよかったのに』(過去の事実に反する願望)。

next:wr:61.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:61.answer: I hope that it will be sunny tomorrow.
next:wr:61.fullSentence: I hope that it will be sunny tomorrow.
next:wr:61.explanation: hopeは実現の見込みがあることに使う直説法(will可)。wish(仮定法)との違いに注意。
next:wr:61.relatedInfo: wishは実現しにくい願望に使う。

next:wr:63.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:63.hint: もし気が変わったら教えてください
next:wr:63.answer: Should you change your mind, please let me know.
next:wr:63.fullSentence: Should you change your mind, please let me know.
next:wr:63.explanation: Should S do『万一〜したら』(未来の可能性が低い仮定、ifの省略による倒置)。

next:wr:65.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:65.hint: 時間を戻せさえすればいいのに
next:wr:65.answer: If only I could turn back time.
next:wr:65.fullSentence: If only I could turn back time.
next:wr:65.explanation: If only+仮定法『〜さえすればいいのに』(＝I wishより強い願望)。
next:wr:65.relatedInfo: 感嘆符で終わることが多い。

next:wr:67.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:67.hint: 頼んでくれれば私のを貸せたのに
next:wr:67.answer: You could have borrowed mine if you had asked me.
next:wr:67.fullSentence: You could have borrowed mine if you had asked me.
next:wr:67.explanation: could have done『〜できたのに(しなかった)』。
next:wr:67.relatedInfo: if節も仮定法過去完了(had asked)にする。

next:wr:69.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:69.hint: もしあなたの助言がなかったら、私は失敗していただろう(過去の仮定)
next:wr:69.answer: If it had not been for your advice, I would have failed.
next:wr:69.fullSentence: If it had not been for your advice, I would have failed.
keyPhrases: If it had not been for
next:wr:69.explanation: If it had not been for A『もしAがなかったら』(過去の仮定)。
next:wr:69.relatedInfo: ＝ Had it not been for A(倒置) ＝ but for A ＝ without A。

next:wr:71.cat: 時制・助動詞・仮定法
next:wr:71.hint: 私の願いが叶うだろう
next:wr:71.explanation: 仮定法の帰結節でよく使われるcome trueのコロケーション。

next:wr:73.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:73.hint: 彼がそう言ったのは間違っていた(人の性質を表す形容詞)
next:wr:73.answer: It was wrong of him to say that.
next:wr:73.fullSentence: It was wrong of him to say that.
next:wr:73.explanation: kind, wise, foolish, careless等『人の性質』を表す形容詞のときはforではなくofを使う。
next:wr:73.relatedInfo: 通常はfor A to doの形をとる。

next:wr:75.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:75.hint: もしあなたの支えがなければ、私たちは成功できなかっただろう
next:wr:75.answer: Without your support, we couldn't have succeeded.
next:wr:75.fullSentence: Without your support, we couldn't have succeeded.
next:wr:75.explanation: without A『もしAがなければ』。仮定法の意味を持つ副詞句(=if A is not/were not)。

next:wr:77.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:77.hint: 彼はパーティーに最初に到着した人だった
next:wr:77.answer: He was the first person to arrive at the party.
next:wr:77.fullSentence: He was the first person to arrive at the party.
next:wr:77.explanation: the first/the last+名詞+to do『最初に/最後に〜する(した)人』(不定詞の形容詞的用法)。
next:wr:77.relatedInfo: the last A to doなら『決してAしない人』の意味にもなる。

next:wr:79.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:79.hint: もし試合に負けたらどうなるだろうか
next:wr:79.answer: What if we lose the game?
next:wr:79.fullSentence: What if we lose the game?
next:wr:79.explanation: What if ~?『もし〜としたらどうなるだろうか』(仮定を含む疑問表現)。
next:wr:79.relatedInfo: 心配・懸念を表すときによく使う。

next:wr:81.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:81.hint: 私を助けてくれる友人が必要だ
next:wr:81.answer: I need friends to help me.
next:wr:81.fullSentence: I need friends to help me.
next:wr:81.explanation: 名詞+to do(形容詞的用法)で、不定詞の意味上の主語が直前の名詞になる例。
next:wr:81.relatedInfo: friends who will help me とも書き換え可能。
